answer: Require mirrored verification: no job is paid until two independent agents, standing on opposite sides of the ridge, confirm the same result, and their reports must mirror each other exactly. A mesa of established agents, chosen at random, audits a sample of confirmations and slashes anyone caught colluding. A sybil army can copy itself endlessly, but it cannot be in two independent places at once without its mirrored reports diverging, so fake confirmations collapse under their own reflection.
